title: More Gear Types
description: Backports copper gear. Adds ruby gear and two new sword types.
body:
Backports copper gear. Adds ruby gear and two new sword types.
Copper gear should work the same as it does in 1.21.9 (The Copper Age).

### Ruby Gear
Rubys can be found in the nether. Ruby gear is ment to be an inbetween for iron and diamond. Ruby pickaxes can mine obsidian, but can't mine netherite. Ruby armor provides 18 armor points in total. All ruby gear has the same durability as the netherite eqivolent making their durability better than diamond.

### Sword Variants
Shortswords and longswords have been added. Shortswords have a faster attack speed, but have the distance you can attack from is decreased by one block. Longswords have a slower attack speed, but have the distance you can attack from is increased by one block.

Shortswords are crafted like this:

![Shortsword Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cf66b4d24fca4eba01ab631c4dd6c7288dd593ec.png)

Longswords are crafted like this:

![Longsword Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2e64097c8c9c0e1b82e91b846422a6894324dcb2.png)


I am not the best texture artist, feel free to make and post resources packs changing textures added by the mod.
